docuLanguageListResources.title: Remarks by Commissioner Brunner on the second Annual Migration Management Cycle
Questions and answers on the second Annual Migration Management Cycle
Commission launches second Annual Migration Management Cycle under the Pact on Migration and Asylum
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission is launching the second Annual Migration Management Cycle, delivering on a core component of the Pact on Migration and Asylum.

docuLanguageListResources.title: EU releases €16 million in humanitarian aid for Myanmar and Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: The European Union has allocated an additional €16 million in humanitarian aid to help communities impacted by the ongoing conflict in Myanmar, as well as Rohingya refugees and their host communities in Bangladesh. These new funds come as escalating conflict in Myanmar continues to increase the needs of the population and to drive displacement within and beyond its borders.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Commission greenlights Finland's final payment request for €331 million under NextGenerationEU
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission greenlighted Finland's sixth and final payment request for €331 million under the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF), the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Commission approves merger between AkzoNobel and Axalta, subject to conditions
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: The European Commission has approved, under the EU Merger Regulation, the proposed merger between coating makers AkzoNobel and Axalta. The approval is conditional upon full compliance with the commitments offered by the two companies.

docuLanguageListResources.title: EU and India conclude negotiations on association to Horizon Europe
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: The European Commission and India have successfully concluded negotiations on India's association to Horizon Europe, the EU's €93.5 billion flagship research and innovation programme.

docuLanguageListResources.title: EU to push for accelerated global climate action at COP31
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: At the COP31 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye, from 9-20 November, the European Union will work with international partners to accelerate global climate action and deliver on the goals of the Paris Agreement.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Commission preliminarily finds TikTok's ‘For You' feed in breach of Digital Services Act for harmful ‘rabbit holes' effect
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission has preliminarily found TikTok in breach of the Digital Services Act (DSA) for the so-called ‘rabbit hole effect' of its recommender system.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Questions and Answers on the 2027 fishing opportunities in the Atlantic, Kattegat and Skagerrak
Commission proposes 2027 fishing opportunities for fish stocks in the Atlantic, Kattegat and Skagerrak
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission adopted its proposal for the 2027 fishing opportunities for 11 fish stocks managed by the EU in the Atlantic, Kattegat and Skagerrak.

docuLanguageListResources.title: European Innovation Council launches €1.8 billion in funding for 2027
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: The European Commission has adopted the 2027 European Innovation Council (EIC) Work Programme, unlocking €1.8 billion to support Europe's most promising deep tech entrepreneurs and researchers.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Remarks by Executive Vice-President Mînzatu on the Education and Skills package
Commission disburses €4.36 billion to Ukraine under the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission disbursed €4.36 billion to Ukraine under the Ukraine Support Loan. This payment includes €3.7 billion for the second instalment of macro-financial assistance (MFA) agreed for 2026 and €658 million under the defence leg of the Loan.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Questions and answers on the Education and Skills package
Commission launches Education and Skills package to tackle declining basic skills, rapid digital change and teacher shortages
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission presents a new Education and Skills Package to reverse the decline in basic skills, help schools make AI and digital technologies work for learning and address teacher shortages.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Statement following meeting on prosperity talks today
€525 million investment set to drive new generation of European chip design companies
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Launching today, the European Chip Design Platform will mobilise €525 million in investment to stimulate a new generation of European chip design companies.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Remarks by High Representative/Vice-President Kallas and Commissioner Kos on the 2026 Enlargement Package
Press remarks by Executive Vice-President Fitto and Commissioner Tzitzikostas on the EU Sustainable Tourism Strategy
2026 Enlargement Package shows that reform commitment delivers progress towards EU membership
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission adopted its annual Enlargement Package, taking stock of progress made by the enlargement partners over the past year and setting out reform priorities for the way forward.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Remarks by Commissioners Šefčovič and Dombrovskis on the 2027 Commission work programme and 2026 Overview Report on Simplification, Implementation and Enforcement
Questions and answers on the 2026 Annual Overview Report on Simplification, Implementation and Enforcement
Questions and answers on the 2027 Commission work programme
Commission unveils 2027 work programme for a stronger and sovereign Europe and reports on simplification efforts
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the Commission adopted its 2027 work programme, setting out its main legislative and non-legislative initiatives for the year ahead. It is accompanied by the 2026 annual progress report on simplification, implementation and enforcement, taking stock of progress towards simpler EU rules and more effective results on the ground.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Questions and answers on the EU Sustainable Tourism Strategy
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Tourism is mainly a Member State responsibility. Why is a European strategy needed?

docuLanguageListResources.title: Commission strengthens Europe's position as the world's leading tourism destination
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: The European Commission today presented a new EU Sustainable Tourism Strategy, to increase the sector's competitiveness, sustainability and resilience.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Commission greenlights Latvia's fifth and final payment request for €504 million under NextGenerationEU
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission greenlighted Latvia's fifth and final payment request for €504 million under the Recovery and Resilience Facility, the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Commission takes new steps to prepare Europeans for growing crisis risks
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: As Europe faces increasingly frequent and complex crises, the European Commission is stepping up efforts to strengthen preparedness across the EU. From helping citizens protect themselves during emergencies to ensuring that national civil protection systems can keep operating when disaster strikes, the EU is delivering concrete measures to make Europe more resilient.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Keynote speech by President von der Leyen at the WinWin Brussels Summit
Commission conditionally approves JD.com's acquisition of CECONOMY under the Foreign Subsidies Regulation
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: The European Commission has approved, under the Foreign Subsidies Regulation ('FSR'), the acquisition of CECONOMY AG ('CECONOMY') by JD.com, Inc. ('JD.com'). The approval is conditional upon full compliance with the commitments offered by the parties.

docuLanguageListResources.title: EU Roma Strategic Framework brings positive progress on Roma rights across the EU with further efforts needed
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: The European Commission has published the third implementation report on the EU Roma Strategic Framework, covering the period from June 2023 to March 2025. The report identifies how the framework is helping advance Roma equality, inclusion and participation across the Union, while also outlining the remaining challenges.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Joint statement by Executive Vice-President Virkkunen, High Representative Kallas and Commissioner McGrath ahead of the International Day to End Impunity for Crimes against Journalists
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Violence against journalists undermines the very foundations of open, free and democratic societies. Yet across the world, journalists continue to be killed, tortured, harassed, detained and forced into exile simply for doing their job and holding power to account.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Joint Statement: The European Union and Canada building together an Alliance for the future
Statement by President von der Leyen following the EU-Canada summit
Opening statement by President von der Leyen at the EU-Canada summit
EU and Canada intensify cooperation in the area of medical countermeasures for preparedness and response to combat health emergencies
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: On Monday 26 October, Hadja Lahbib, EU Commissioner for Preparedness and Crisis Management, and the Honourable Mélanie Joly, Minister of Industry and Minister responsible for Canada Economic Development for Quebec Regions, met to reaffirm the strong Canada-EU partnership on health emergency preparedness and response.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Commission disburses almost €6.5 billion to France, Austria and Luxembourg under NextGenerationEU
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission disbursed €6.1 billion to France, €306 million to Austria, and €92.2 million to Luxembourg.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Commission takes a key step forward on 2027 financial support for Ukraine
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission took another step in the implementation of the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan,  which will provide Ukraine with essential budgetary support and defence products in 2026 and 2027. The package adopted today includes a proposal for the Council to approve the remaining loan amount of €45 billion for 2027.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Europeans overwhelmingly support stronger EU civil protection cooperation based on solidarity, new Eurobarometer shows
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Europeans continue to show very strong support for a coordinated European approach to disaster preparedness and response, according to the latest Special Eurobarometer on EU Civil Protection published today by the European Commission.

docuLanguageListResources.title: EU announces establishment and composition of PreparEU Advisory Group on European Disaster Preparedness
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission is establishing the PreparEU Advisory Group, tasked with providing strategic advice to President of the Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, and Commissioner for Equality; Preparedness and Crisis Management Hadja Lahbib on how to best address accelerating disaster risks, including extreme weather events and wildfires

docuLanguageListResources.title: Commission greenlights Czechia's seventh and final payment request for €951 million under NextGenerationEU
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission greenlighted Czechia's seventh payment request worth €951 million under the Recovery and Resilience Facility, the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Keynote speech by President von der Leyen on EU-Canada relations at the C.D. Howe Institute
New Eurobarometer survey shows young people's growing engagement and views on participatory democracy, youth issues, and EU's added value in their lives
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission published a Eurobarometer survey showing young Europeans' growing engagement with and views on democracy.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Joint statement by High Representative/Vice-President Kallas and Commissioner Kos on the early parliamentary elections in Serbia
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: On Sunday 25 October, the people of Serbia turned out in historic numbers to make their voices heard. Voters have given the next government a strong mandate for change. We look forward to seeing this being realised in practice.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Remarks by Executive Vice-President Virkkunen and Commissioner Brunner on strengthening Frontex and the digitalisation of the return process
Commission proposes to reinforce Frontex:  stronger border protection, a greater role on returns and more effective crisis response
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission is proposing to further strengthen Frontex, reinforcing its capacity to protect the external borders and turning it into the EU's central actor for returns.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Remarks by Executive Vice-President Ribera and Commissioner Hoekstra at the press conference  on the EU framework for climate resilience
Questions and answers on the Commission proposal to reinforce Frontex: stronger border protection, a greater role on returns and more effective crisis response
Questions and answers on the EU Climate Resilience Framework
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: What is the objective of the new EU Climate Resilience Framework, and why is it necessary now?

docuLanguageListResources.title: Commission presents Climate Resilience Framework for a better prepared and protected Europe
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: The European Commission today presented an EU Framework for Climate Resilience to strengthen Europe's ability to anticipate, prepare for, and manage climate risks.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Statement by Commissioner Serafin on the presentation of the High-Level Group Report on the Future of the European Commission's Civil Service

Statement by President von der Leyen with Commissioner Serafin and Catherine Day, Chair of the High-Level Group on the Future of the Commission's Civil Service, on the occasion of the handover of the report by the external advisers on the Large-scale review
Commission launches T-MED Investment Platform with up to €4.5 billion in EU guarantees
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission launched the T-MED Investment Platform, to mobilise large-scale investment in renewable energy and clean technologies across the Mediterranean. The platform is a key component of the Trans-Mediterranean Renewable Energy and Clean Tech Cooperation Initiative (T-MED), a flagship initiative of the Pact for the Mediterranean.

docuLanguageListResources.title: An outside-in perspective on the future of the European Commission's civil service
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the High-Level group chaired by Catherine Day shared the results of their reflections on the Large-Scale Review with President von der Leyen and Commissioner Serafin.

docuLanguageListResources.title: EU citizens think innovative foods can be useful but want more information, new Eurobarometer shows
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission published the results of a new Special Eurobarometer on food innovation, offering an EU-wide overview of how Europeans view innovative foods, ingredients and crops.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Speech by President von der Leyen to the Hungarian National Assembly on the occasion of the 70th anniversary of the Hungarian Revolution of 1956
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: 70 years ago, on a bright, sunny afternoon, the young people of Hungary came together and changed the course of history. They rose, with peaceful intent, moral clarity, and astonishing bravery, to fight for freedom, for democracy, and for Europe. The reprisals were swift, and bloody. The Soviets sent tanks and troops against workers and students. But by the example of their courage, the martyrs of 1956 inspired hope.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Commission proposes stronger recognition of European heritage sites*
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: The European Commission has proposed to renew and reinforce the legal framework of the European Heritage Label. The scheme was adopted in 2011 aiming to offer a recognition awarded by the European Union to sites - buildings, monuments, documents - of exceptional symbolic value that have played a key role in shaping Europe's history, culture, and integration.

docuLanguageListResources.title: EU Civil Protection Mechanism turns 25*
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: For 25 years, European countries have been joining forces to save lives when disasters strike under the EU Civil Protection Mechanism. This is one of the best examples of European solidarity in action.

docuLanguageListResources.title: EU announces an additional €22.5 million to reinforce humanitarian assistance in Yemen
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: The European Commission is releasing €22.5 million in humanitarian aid to Yemen, in addition to the €87.5 million previously allocated for 2026, to address the consequences of the renewed conflict escalation and the critical needs of millions of people.
